description: This week, CreepCast takes a look back at an internet classic, the legend of Jeff the Killer! A story that’s impacted modern horror culture gets a re-visit. Will it live up to the hype or be a hilarious reminder of early internet horror’s quality? (spoilers: it’s the second one). Join us for a walk
